name: cpsc-recalls-mcp-server
description: Search and retrieve US consumer product recalls from the CPSC (Consumer Product Safety Commission) via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

CPSC_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp page limits
CPSC_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Accept a larger limit and serve up to 500 search or 1,000 recent recalls per page.

CPSC_NORMALIZE_RECALL_NUMBERS.title: Accept printed recall numbers
CPSC_NORMALIZE_RECALL_NUMBERS.description: Accept the optional hyphen from CPSC recall pages, surrounding whitespace, and uppercase suffixes.
